info.name: EazyUdhar Admin API v1
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for EazyUdhar Admin Panel APIs.

**Setup**
1. Set `base_url` (e.g. `http://192.168.0.145:8099/admin-api/v1`)
2. Run **1. Auth > Login** — tokens are saved automatically
3. All other requests use Bearer `access_token`

**Seed admin:** `admin@eazyudhar.com` / `Admin@2026`

See `API_REQUIREMENTS.md` for full request/response shapes.

request.description: Returns access + refresh JWT and admin user profile.
